fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 2009 Audi Q7 SUV.
findings: Torn and worn leather on the driver seat side bolster
Creased, worn leather on the front seat backs and second-row seats
Dust and haze on the dash top and center console trim
Streaks and spots on the rear moonroof glass
Exterior white paint looks reasonably clean but slightly dull in low evening light
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Q7. The leather looks pretty worn on the seats, and the dash and moonroof glass could use a cleanup before buyers come out. We do mobile pre-sale details, including a leather clean and condition and an exterior wash and wax, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
